posts.cooked:
Plague Rat - Plaguebearer

Plague Rat [85]

In Play: Plague Locus[13]

Trash:

Additional Effects:

* Whenver a card named Infection is destroyed, Plague Rat deals each hero target H toxic damage

* Increase damage dealt by Plague Rat and infected heroes by 1

*EV: Plague Rat deals each Hero target 1 irreducible melee damage

* Plague Locus: Increase damage dealt by Plague Rat and each infected hero by 1

* Plague Locus: EV: Plague Rat regains X HP, where X is the number of infected heroes

__________________________________________________________________________________________________

Start of Villain Turn: N/A

Play a Card: Noxious Bite: Plague Rat deals Tempest or Wraith 7 Toxic damage.  A copy of Infection is put into play in front of a hero

End of Villain Turn:: Plague Rat deals each hero target 3 irreducible melee damage

 

______________________________________________________________________________________________________

Plague Rat [85]

 

In Play: Infection, in play in front of hero of your choice

Trash: Noxious Bite

Additional Effects:

* Whenver a card named Infection is destroyed, Plague Rat deals each hero target H toxic damage

* Increase damage dealt by Plague Rat and infected heroes by 1

* EV: Plague Rat deals each Hero target 1 irreducible melee damage

* Plague Locus: Increase damage dealt by Plague Rat and each infected hero by 1

* Plague Locus: EV: Plague Rat regains X HP, where X is the number of infected heroes

* Infected Hero deals themselves 1+1+1 irreducbile toxic damage at the start of their turn
